d: An engineer from Essex is hoping for investment in his home sensor system for the elderly.
A couple face a roasting over their projections for their vitamin-infused coffee.
A translatlantic duo pitch their unique coffee lid.
A plucky entrepreneur pitches an idea for genetically personalized meal shakes.
Pitches include a premium whisky subscription business and a clever sand-removing powder.
A former merchant navy officer tries to make a stand with his novel tablet holder.

In business, it's all about the pitch – that elusive ability of an entrepreneur to stand tall, talk smart, and capture an audience whenever and wherever opportunity knocks. Each week, with big investment dollars on the line, real-life business owners must pitch like a pro under the dead-eyed scrutiny of five self-made business titans, known as 'The Dragons'
